subject: [AMBER] How to build the charmmgen program

messages.author: Kotaro TANAKA
messages.body:
Hello amber community,
Can any one tell me how to build the charmmgen program in AmberTools22?
Following this archive (
http://archive.ambermd.org/201905/0313.html
),
I have added the charmmgen target to the PROGS variable in
AmberTools/src/antechamber/Makefile.
Then I followed the basic installation guide in the Amber 2022 reference
manual (section2.1),
but the charmmgen program was not installed.
Thanks,
Kotaro

messages.author: Kotaro TANAKA
messages.body:
Hi,
I found a solution by myself.
I added charmmgen to the PROGRAMS list in
amber22_src/AmberTools/src/antechamber/CMakeLists.txt (line 14), then
followed the installation guide in the Amber reference.
Thanks,
Kotaro
